items.value: Candidate 3f55de3f1: 242 targeted Elixir tests and the CLI package test pass.
Production: eight migrations applied, clean build-aside swap completed, postcheck passed, and the service soak recorded zero error/exception/crash/5xx matches.

Real fixtures: public and email returned 200 with semantic lists; CLI/TUI stayed within 80 characters; authenticated Studio rendered 120, 68, and 80 blocks with 13, 43, and 17 list items and zero browser errors.
Baseline: measure deployed current-format behavior on good, bad, and edge fixtures.
Diverge: exercise three materially distinct repair formats without production mutation.
Attack: run hostile reader, width, malformed legacy, preservation, and idempotence trials.
Converge: freeze one format, accessibility behavior, and migration/rollback rule.
Pilot: three disjoint batches through the full cross-reader gate; capacity is the smallest fully passing batch.

content.value: Three exact legendary-experimenter reports passed the recovery validator (index SHA-256 ca7056347a0ddbf8b49f7162cdc0b3fe95d0b0907a38059f63c09a6dd7dd4ffc). Seven of eight fixtures render across the available public, email, CLI/API, and 80-column TUI paths. Felix Pristine still fails with invalid_blocks; authenticated Studio parity remains an explicit gate; and reader success does not erase editorial density.

blocks.title: Validated baseline — no winner, hard gates remain

items.value: PPR-E01: two controls preserve sampled meaning; the earlier Paper-perfection control loses an exact Strategize command in rendered readers; Studio was not verified.
PPR-E02: 7/8 fixtures render; Felix returns 422 invalid_blocks; four weak sources still contain 98 empty paragraphs, 36 long paragraphs, and 355 top-level blocks.
PPR-E03: TUI output stays within 80 columns for the seven renderable fixtures, but cross-reader factual/visual parity is incomplete and Felix remains unreadable.

Decision: advance only reproducible structural patterns into divergence; quarantine Felix until its blocks validate; require authenticated Studio and idempotence evidence before any winner or capacity claim.

content.value: PPR-E04–06 passed the recovery round validator (index SHA-256 5e96005d9bf08a3d4d4aa53d0284994335ae2e76cca98387211166a3cf41d5cc). Minimal cleanup proved deterministic scaffold removal and idempotence in scratch; concise synthesis produced a strong decision-first shape; layered appendix kept evidence homes explicit. Every lane still blocks winner selection until instantiated candidates pass all five real reader and preservation gates.

blocks.title: Three distinct formats validated — no winner yet

items.value: Minimal cleanup: advance as the safety control; 98 empty scaffolds removed, 126 text nodes tightened, structure and authored tokens preserved, byte-identical second pass.
Concise synthesis: carry into attack, but require claim-level fact maps and 20/20 real reader cells; compression alone is not proof.
Layered appendix: attack as a format, not a winner; essential evidence must remain visible, ordered, command-safe, and accessible.
Felix remains quarantined under invalid_blocks; no format may conceal or reconstruct malformed authority.

content.value: PPR-E07–09 passed the recovery round validator (index SHA-256 32fd7f96bb2531f8a0ab25a6175279e09ddf59c31c21cff885c15f16a46c4d20). Hostile readers, hostile content, and truth/accessibility agree: no Round-2 candidate clears the zero-failure winner gate. CycleFleet now records Attack 3/3 with zero invalid results.

blocks.title: Attack sealed 3/3 — no winner survives unchanged

items.value: Reader attack: advance a concise synthesis front plus an instantiated lossless appendix; eliminate decisive ellipsis and unknown-block placeholders.
Content attack: 200 scratch cells produced 160 valid preservation passes and 40 expected malformed-input rejections; installed candidate readers remain unproven.
Truth attack: reject generic whitespace tightening after it joined `/test` and `/internal/manifest`; normalization must respect authored node and link boundaries.
Reader authority: Felix remains quarantined; the T3 control still diverges in authenticated Studio; exact command/link recovery and post-JS accessibility remain hard gates.

Converge must produce one eight-fixture hybrid with a summary-first reader shape, exhaustive fact/provenance map, shared malformed-block diagnostics, non-color state labels, idempotence, rollback, and zero reader failures.

content.value: PPR-E10–12 passed the recovery round validator (index SHA-256 11063d4576051cb183d90cb5f6baa150152f6f7c7749d2288afda2482ca84a84). The three lanes converge on `source-backed-front-lossless-appendix-v1`: an exact source-backed front, a lossless appendix, explicit accessibility semantics, and a fenced migration envelope. CycleFleet records Converge 3/3 with zero invalid results.

blocks.title: Converge sealed 3/3 — one format advances to Pilot

items.value: Format: eight fixtures × five scratch projections preserve the exact source once, keep the 80-column TUI bounded, and place exhaustive evidence behind a concise source-pointer front.
Accessibility: all 40 modeled cells use ordered headings, visible non-color state labels, summary-first table fallback, and one shared fail-closed malformed-content diagnostic.
Migration: exact source preservation, revision fencing, node-boundary safety, deterministic second pass, rollback, and protected link/command/fact sentinels pass the isolated gate.
Authority: Felix remains quarantined and the T3 Studio divergence remains an installed-reader Pilot gate; scratch projection success is not production parity.
Pilot must run three disjoint representative batches through installed Studio, TUI at 80 columns, email, public reader, and CLI/API, accepting capacity only at zero hard failures.

content.value: PPR-E13–15 are structurally valid typed reports (index SHA-256 675bc415374fe7694f14874a4cf6b660d5d7484fdd8c93866c7413e54c87c35e), but the frozen zero-failure seal gate failed (gate SHA-256 4a4edbcf3a2fefa65e0b68f86972ea551a5385db9f886d6552fe9290b76690ca). Pilot A found three hard failures: the scratch candidate has no isolated candidate-scoped route through the installed Studio, TUI, email, public, and CLI/API readers. Pilot B and C passed their scratch projections, but those results cannot override the installed-reader failure.

items.value: Failure: all three Pilot A fixtures preserve their source exactly in scratch, but the candidate itself cannot be exercised in the installed readers without an injection route.
Boundary: successful modeled or live-equivalent projections are useful implementation evidence, not installed production parity and not permission to seal capacity.
Controls: the eight pinned fixtures are covered exactly once across batches 3/3/2; Felix remains fail-closed with three untyped legacy blocks and publish_allowed=false.
Decision: do not seal this immutable wave. Build an isolated candidate-reader harness, then repeat Pilot in a new wave at the same zero-failure threshold.

LEGENDARY CYCLE · RECOVERY WAVE · 2026-07-27

Paper perfection recovery wave — deployed readers, renewed pilot

User wish

Sounds great - lets go

Strategic direction

Preserve the 105 completed Survey, Verify, and prior Experiment reports as historical evidence. Freeze the current live corpus again, rerun the exact five-round Experiment/Pilot against the deployed renderer, and seal capacity only if every declared reader and preservation threshold passes.

Scale profile

  • Inventory: 560 live Papers, frozen 2026-07-27.
  • Readers: authenticated Studio, TUI at 80 columns, email, public HTML, and CLI/API.
  • Stop condition: 15/15 renewed Experiment results, zero hard reader failures, frozen golden fixtures, and a nonzero proven batch capacity.
Frozen boundary The recovery-wave control Paper was published after the 560-unit freeze. It is explicitly excluded from its own repair inventory to avoid self-reference; the live corpus is therefore 561 Papers while this immutable inventory remains 560.

Survey plan

60 exact read-only assignments Twenty waves of three epic-surveyor assignments will partition the 560 revision-pinned Papers once, by stable numeric range and reader risk. Every report names checked units, sample size, found/not-found/partial verdicts, evidence, risks, and unvisited ranges; overlaps and omissions are rejected rather than averaged away.

Agent fleet

EXPERIMENT · PILOT 3/3 RECORDED · CAPACITY UNSEALED Legendary CycleFleet 96fb88c2-fa29-417f-b171-c8a929768688: 560 inventoried; 15 typed assignments started, 15 completed, 0 invalid assignments, and 0 invalid results. Experiment rounds: baseline 3, diverge 3, attack 3, converge 3, pilot 3. Pilot failure rate 1.0 exceeds the frozen threshold 0.0, so proven capacity is 0 and no Build assignments may be derived from this wave.

Deployed recovery proof

  • Candidate 3f55de3f1: 242 targeted Elixir tests and the CLI package test pass.

  • Real fixtures: public and email returned 200 with semantic lists; CLI/TUI stayed within 80 characters; authenticated Studio rendered 120, 68, and 80 blocks with 13, 43, and 17 list items and zero browser errors.

Renewed Experiment plan

  1. Baseline: measure deployed current-format behavior on good, bad, and edge fixtures.

  4. Converge: freeze one format, accessibility behavior, and migration/rollback rule.
  5. Pilot: three disjoint batches through the full cross-reader gate; capacity is the smallest fully passing batch.

  • PPR-E03: TUI output stays within 80 columns for the seven renderable fixtures, but cross-reader factual/visual parity is incomplete and Felix remains unreadable.
  • Decision: advance only reproducible structural patterns into divergence; quarantine Felix until its blocks validate; require authenticated Studio and idempotence evidence before any winner or capacity claim.

  • Layered appendix: attack as a format, not a winner; essential evidence must remain visible, ordered, command-safe, and accessible.
  • Felix remains quarantined under invalid_blocks; no format may conceal or reconstruct malformed authority.
